summary.zh-CN: 项目现在可以持续追踪工作项、产物与 AI 进展，桌面端会话列表和消息发送也恢复正常。
summary.en-US: Projects can now track work items, artifacts, and AI progress over time, with desktop session lists and message sending restored.

title.en-US: Track work and artifacts over time

body.zh-CN: 项目主页通过概览、列表和看板展示工作项、状态历史、关联产物、AI 进展和待关注事项。
body.en-US: The project home uses overview, list, and board views to present work items, status history, linked artifacts, AI progress, and attention items.

body.zh-CN: 用户可以为应用授予只读或读写目录，并随时替换或撤销授权。
body.en-US: Users can grant read-only or read-write folders to apps and replace or revoke those grants at any time.

title.zh-CN: Portable Action 共享运行资源
title.en-US: Shared runtime resources for Portable Actions

body.zh-CN: 并发 Action 共享 Runtime、Engine 和 Component，同时保持每次调用的状态隔离。
body.en-US: Concurrent Actions share the Runtime, Engine, and Component while preserving isolated state for every call.

title.zh-CN: 会话列表和消息发送恢复
title.en-US: Session lists and message sending restored

body.zh-CN: 会话摘要和消息会可靠写入本地数据库，并在桌面端重启后继续可用。
body.en-US: Session summaries and messages are stored reliably in the local database and remain available after a desktop restart.
